steps.text: Click the "My exports" tab. This is where you ask for a copy of your data and find the exports you already asked for.
steps.title: Open "My exports"

steps.text: Click "Export my data". The archive gathers everything OptimCE holds about you, in every module: your account, your members, your meters and their curves, your documents and your invoices. For security, an export needs a recent sign-in: if yours is more than five minutes old, the app asks for your password, then resumes the request on its own.
steps.title: Ask for the export

steps.text: The export shows "In preparation", then turns "Ready" by itself: the list updates without reloading the page. You can also leave it: a notification and an email tell you when it is ready. The file stays available for seven days.
steps.title: Wait for "Ready"

steps.title: Wait for "Ready"

steps.text: Click "Download": the ZIP file is saved to your computer. Open index.html inside it to read its contents service by service; the data itself is in JSON and CSV, readable by other software. For your safety, the email never contains the file: you download it from the app only.
steps.title: Download the archive
